items.text_th: สนุกมากก กลับมาเล่นหลายครั้งมาก เป็นเกมที่แบบสะอาดเหมือนใช้ชีวิตในแบบที่เราอยากใช้
items.text_vn: Vui lắmm, quay lại chơi nhiều lần lắm rồi. Là game kiểu trong sáng, như được sống cuộc sống theo cách mình muốn.
items.summary_vn: Khen game vui, lành mạnh, đã quay lại chơi nhiều lần
items.text_vn_machine: Phản hồi tích cực về trải nghiệm chung và quảng cáo. Đây là tóm tắt phân loại; cần đối chiếu nguyên văn tiếng Thái.
items.text_en: Sooo fun, I've come back to it many times. It's a wholesome kind of game, like living life the way you want.
items.summary_en: Says the game is fun and wholesome; has returned many times.
Says the game is really fun.

items.text_th: ยังไม่ได้เข้าไปเล่นเลยค่ะ เกมน่าสนใจมาก อยากเล่นสุดๆแต่ไม่ได้เล่นเพราะหน้าโหลดนานมากๆค่ะรอเกือบเป็นช่วงโมงแล้ว เลยไม่รอแล้วเพราะจากเบื่อๆจะเล่นเกมคลายเครียดพอมาเจอหน้าโหลดนานอย่างนี้ยิ่งเบื่อยิ่งเครียดไปหมด โห่ไรวะคนไทย
items.text_vn: Chưa vào chơi được luôn ạ. Game hấp dẫn lắm, muốn chơi cực kỳ mà không chơi được vì màn hình tải lâu quá, đợi gần cả tiếng rồi nên thôi không đợi nữa. Đang chán định chơi game xả stress, gặp màn hình tải lâu thế này càng chán càng stress hơn. Haizz, gì vậy trời, người Thái mình đây (?).
items.summary_vn: Màn hình tải gần một tiếng, chưa vào được game nên bỏ cuộc.
items.text_en: Haven't even been able to get in. The game looks so appealing, I really want to play but can't because the loading screen takes forever. I waited almost an hour so I gave up. I was bored and wanted to play to de-stress, and a loading screen this long just makes me more bored and stressed. Sigh, what is this, I'm Thai here (?).
items.summary_en: Loading screen took almost an hour; gave up without getting in.

items.text_th: สนุกนะเอาจิง อิสสระสุด เริสเลยหละ
items.text_vn: Vui thật đó, tự do cực, đỉnh luôn.
items.summary_vn: Khen game vui, tự do, rất đỉnh.
items.text_en: Really fun, so much freedom, amazing.
items.summary_en: Says the game is fun, free-form and amazing.

items.text_th: เอาโฆษณาออกเถอะตอนไม่มีมันก็ดีอยู่แล้วจะเอาเข้ามาทำไม
items.text_vn: Bỏ quảng cáo đi, lúc chưa có thì đã tốt rồi, thêm vào làm gì.
items.summary_vn: Yêu cầu bỏ quảng cáo, trước khi có quảng cáo game tốt hơn.
items.text_en: Remove the ads, it was fine before they were added, why add them?
items.summary_en: Asks to remove ads; the game was better without them.
